title: Is your honey really raw?

items.text: Raw honey often crystallises in the cold. That is natural. Warm the jar gently.

caption:
Is your honey really raw? 🍯 Label Check #2

Flip your honey jar and check 3 things: does it say raw or unprocessed, does it name where the honey comes from, and is honey the only ingredient?

Raw honey often turns thick or crystallises in cold weather. That's natural. Just warm the jar gently in a bowl of warm water.
